def test_coverage_ignores_weekends_and_holidays(planning: PlanningStore) -> None:
    planning.available_employees[0].absences = [
        Absence(start_date=date(2026, 10, 3), end_date=date(2026, 10, 4)),
    ]
    planning.available_employees[1].absences = [
        Absence(start_date=date(2026, 10, 6), end_date=date(2026, 10, 6)),
    ]
    view = _view(planning, holidays={date(2026, 10, 6)})
    assert [cell.level for cell in view.coverage] == ["ok", "ok"]
    assert view.bottleneck_label == ""


def test_totals_next_absence_and_upcoming(planning: PlanningStore) -> None:
    view = _view(planning)
    assert view.total_days == 4
    assert view.total_label == "4 Arbeitstage abwesend"
    assert [row.total_days for row in view.rows] == [1, 3]
    assert [row.next_label for row in view.rows] == ["ab 30.09.", "ab 06.10."]
    assert [item.relative for item in view.upcoming] == ["morgen", "in 7 Tagen"]
    assert view.upcoming[1].period == "Di 06.10. – Do 08.10. · 3 AT"
    assert view.upcoming[0].period == "Mi 30.09. · 1 AT"
    later = _view(planning, today=date(2026, 10, 7))
    assert [item.relative for item in later.upcoming] == ["läuft bis 08.10."]
    assert later.rows[0].next_label == ""

content.text:
I removed the "X Arbeitstage abwesend" badge from the absence view.

- **Badge:** taken out of the filter row in [planning_filter_row.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/planning_filter_row.py). The bottleneck badge next to it is still there.
- **Unused fields:** nothing else used `total_label` or the view-wide `total_days`, so I removed them from `AbsenceGanttView` in [planning_models.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/states/planning_models.py) and [planning_gantt.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/services/planning_gantt.py). The per-person totals are unchanged.
- **Test:** I removed the two checks for those fields from [test_planning_gantt.py](components/alloq-project/tests/test_planning_gantt.py).

`task lint` passes and the gantt tests pass. Nothing is committed, and I didn't check the page in the browser.

Two tests in `test_planning_legend.py` fail. My change didn't cause this. They look for a legend entry "Monatsbeginn", but that text doesn't appear anywhere in the source code. It's probably left over from your planning-readability work in progress.
